text: Your team is talking. A bug needs fixing. But the answers are somewhere else.
Meet Chatty, your AI teammate inside the meeting. Built to connect with your ticketing and work systems.
With a supported connection and your permission, she can read your data, answer questions, and take approved actions.
Keep talking. Ask a follow-up. Turn a decision into a ticket, and shape the draft together.
Refine the draft. Check the details. Chatty gives you a short summary, then asks before taking action.
Say, sure, go ahead. This GitHub example turns your decision into an issue you can verify.
When you're done, say, Chatty, stop. Okay. She stays quiet, and keeps listening.
Your tools. Your data. One conversation. Chatty. From conversation to action.
